projects.title: TenantGuard
projects.summary: B2B admin console where four roles see different things, enforced by Auth0 RBAC and permission-checked APIs.
projects.description:
A multi-tenant admin console that shows how B2B SaaS authorization should work with Auth0. Users sign in through branded Universal Login and get one of four roles: Tenant Admin, Security Analyst, Billing Manager or Viewer.

Every API route checks permissions from the access token and returns an explicit allow or deny, so you can watch authorization decisions happen. A Token Inspector shows the session, granted permissions and custom claims from an Auth0 Action without exposing raw tokens.

Runs on Vercel with separate staging and production tenants. Next up: Organizations, MFA and Management API tenant admin.

projects.title: TripShare
projects.summary: Carpool matching that pairs travelers on overlapping routes to split cost and cut emissions.
projects.description: Matches travelers whose itineraries overlap so they can share a ride. I built registration, the trip matching logic and a CMS-backed admin layer, shaped by persona research, and shipped it through a CI/CD pipeline.

projects.title: FAST Firmware Fuzzer
projects.summary: Extended the SAFIREFUZZ firmware fuzzer to find gaps between what a spec says and what the code does.
projects.description: Firmware drifts from its specification. I extended the SAFIREFUZZ framework to combine signals from the spec, the code and the existing test suite, so the fuzzer goes after those blind spots. Fixed core bugs along the way and added support for legacy systems.

projects.title: Pizzeria Manager
projects.summary: Java and SQL backend that runs orders and inventory for a simulated pizza chain.
projects.description: An object-oriented Java backend over a normalized SQL schema on AWS RDS. Handles dine-in, pickup and delivery orders and keeps inventory in sync as orders come in.

projects.title: DROWN Attack
projects.summary: Ran the DROWN attack on an SSLv2 server, recovered its RSA private key, then shut the hole.
projects.description: DROWN abuses servers that still speak SSLv2 to break modern TLS. I used SSLv2 as an oracle to recover the server's RSA private key, showed what that exposes, then applied and verified the mitigations.

projects.title: Space Hangman
projects.summary: Space-themed hangman on Flask, wired to several external APIs.
projects.description: Classic hangman with a space theme. Flask backend, HTML5 and CSS frontend, and several external APIs feeding the game so rounds stay fresh.

projects.title: System Monitoring Tool
projects.summary: Python CLI that tracks CPU, memory and network in real time and flags anomalies.
projects.description: Collects system metrics with psutil, plots them live with matplotlib and raises an alert when CPU, memory or network activity crosses a threshold.

projects.title: VoiceRx
projects.summary: Alexa voice interface that lets clinicians update medical records hands free.
projects.description: Clinicians lose hours to data entry. VoiceRx lets them read and update electronic medical records by talking to Amazon Alexa, taking the clicks out of routine updates.

projects.title: HealthFit
projects.summary: REST API that turns a weight goal into a daily calorie target.
projects.description: A Python REST service that takes a user's weight goal and returns a daily calorie target based on published nutrition research. Endpoints are secured with OAuth.

projects.title: TweetFeel
projects.summary: RNN sentiment model that reads the emotion behind tweets.
projects.description: A full NLP pipeline: cleaning, embeddings and a recurrent neural network that classifies the emotion behind each tweet.

projects.title: Neural Style Transfer
projects.summary: Deep learning app that repaints a photo in the style of another image.
projects.description: Neural style transfer in Python. A network optimizes a new image to keep the content of one photo and the style of another. I also explored its use in art therapy.

projects.title: IoT Home Automation
projects.summary: NodeMCU firmware that puts ordinary appliances on Wi-Fi at low cost.
projects.description: A NodeMCU board and a relay, driven by Java firmware, switch regular household appliances over Wi-Fi. A cheap retrofit instead of buying new smart devices.

projects.title: Fraud Detection
projects.summary: KNN fraud detector tuned for heavily imbalanced credit card data.
projects.description: Fraud is rare, which makes it easy to miss. I built a K-Nearest Neighbors classifier with custom features and tuned distance metrics, and judged it on precision and recall instead of accuracy to catch as much fraud as possible.

Run onboarding workshops on Universal Login, Organizations, Actions, MFA, Passkeys and Attack Protection for web, mobile and API teams.
Advise customers on identity for AI agents: token vaulting, scoped delegation, machine to machine auth and consent.
Wrote migration playbooks and reference builds that the consulting org now uses to onboard customers faster.

experience.summary: Owned production Auth0 for Newline, Fifth Third's commercial banking platform, and planned its move to a new identity platform.
highlights: Stood up and ran the production Auth0 tenant for external banking customers and internal staff.
Designed SSO, adaptive MFA and step-up flows over OAuth 2.0, OIDC and SAML, tuned to commercial banking risk.
Built Auth0 Actions, Rules and Hooks for token enrichment, registration, credential recovery and risk checks.

Ran SailPoint IdentityIQ joiner, mover and leaver workflows and worked with CyberArk teams to cut orphaned admin access.
Rolled out MFA and adaptive MFA across legacy and cloud platforms.

experience.summary: Two-month internship building automation and internal tools for network operations.
highlights: Wrote JavaScript and Python scripts and internal APIs that sped up deployments and environment setup.
Added logging, health checks and credential handling to internal tools. My first real security work.
